findings.description: Text-turn priming was wrong: observe(TurnStarted) sets active_turn_id (inbound.rs:121-125), so plan_turn returns TurnSteer, not TurnStart. Injecting TurnStarted before the mobile UserMessage would make the test assert TurnStart but get TurnSteer. (Haiku reviewer flagged the prerequisite was missing from the AC; rubber-duck identified the deeper error that the prerequisite event must be ThreadStarted, not TurnStarted.)
findings.resolution: AC + Risk Areas + US-002 corrected to prime with a root ThreadStarted (parent_thread_id==None -> lock_primary_if_root sets only primary_thread_id, no active turn) so plan_turn returns Start. Documented the TurnStarted/ItemStarted/TurnStarted+TurnCompleted alternatives.
findings.suggestedFix: Use a root ThreadStarted to establish the idle primary thread.

findings.description: US-001 must add the new #[cfg(test)] #[path = "attach_e2e_tests.rs"] mod e2e_tests; wiring (attach.rs currently only wires attach_tests.rs at 548-550) so US-002 has a compile target.
findings.resolution: US-001 strategy + story decomposition + stories-outline now explicitly include adding the module wiring with a placeholder so the crate compiles.
findings.suggestedFix: Fold the module wiring into US-001.

findings.description: AEAD-failure drop happens in decrypt_and_route (session.rs:629-633) BEFORE an InboundEvent exists. A harness that injects InboundEvents via a test-owned inbound_tx bypasses the crypto boundary, so the AEAD-drop scenario would be dishonest / only re-test the existing unit path.
findings.resolution: Plan now specifies two inbound wiring modes: direct test inbound_tx for RPC scenarios; the SessionClient::new inbound_rx + client.fetch_messages() against a wiremock undecryptable message for AEAD-drop (exercises the real decrypt/drop). AC + US-004 updated.
findings.suggestedFix: Drive fetch_messages with an undecryptable message through the real SessionClient inbound path.

findings.description: The generic spawned core needs explicit Send/Sync/'static bounds: trait AppServerHandle: Send + Sync, futures + Send + '_, request_typed<T: DeserializeOwned + Send + 'static>, run_attach_core<H: AppServerHandle + 'static>. Without them US-001 can fail to compile when the future is tokio::spawned.
findings.resolution: Architecture now gives the exact trait signature with all bounds; Technical Constraints + US-001 AC + Risk Areas reference it.
findings.suggestedFix: Spell the Send + Sync supertrait + Send futures + 'static spawn bound.

findings.description: The tokio::select! loop processes outbound (approval ServerRequest) and inbound (permission) independently; sending approval + permission back-to-back can process permission first (before pending_approvals is populated) -> handle_permission drops the unknown id -> flaky. yield_now is not a correctness barrier.
findings.resolution: Risk Areas + US-003 now require a deterministic observable barrier (inject a mapped transcript event after the approval and await its /v3 POST capture; FIFO on the single tap proves the approval was processed) before sending the permission.
findings.suggestedFix: Use a captured-POST barrier, not yield_now.

findings.description: The cited reusable fixtures are private fns in sibling #[cfg(test)] modules (session_tests.rs, mapping_tests.rs, inbound_tests.rs); a child module of attach.rs cannot call them. 'Reuse existing fixtures' is infeasible.
findings.resolution: Plan + In-Scope + Files + US-002 changed to duplicate minimal fixtures locally in attach_e2e_tests.rs (a shared pub(crate) test_support module noted as a wider-footprint alternative, not recommended).

findings.description: 'malformed-decision -> fail-safe-deny' is underspecified and may contradict current logic (approved is authoritative; false/missing -> abort->cancel unless exactly 'denied'). Claiming a 'deny' semantic could imply a hidden behavior change.
findings.resolution: AC + US-003 reworded to PIN the current resolve_payload/canonical_decision behavior (no new semantic); an Open Question flags that 'invalid => decline' would be a separate behavior-change story.
findings.suggestedFix: Assert current behavior; do not impose a new deny semantic.

findings.description: default-off is only partly verifiable from cargo test -p codex-happy: Feature::RemoteSession gate is in app.rs (out of scope) and already covered by invariant 55. Overlay can only test should_skip_attach idempotency.
findings.resolution: AC + Open Questions reworded so the overlay-ownable assertion is should_skip_attach/maybe_attach idempotency with a cross-reference to invariant 55 for the feature gate.
findings.suggestedFix: Scope default-off to the idempotency skip + invariant cross-reference.

findings.description: #[tokio::test(start_paused = true)] requires Tokio's test-util feature, which is NOT in codex-happy dev-deps (only macros + rt-multi-thread). The draft suggested start_paused as a determinism fallback.
findings.resolution: Removed the start_paused suggestion; Risk Areas now mandates observable barriers and notes start_paused would need a new dev-dep (avoided to keep zero-new-dependency).
findings.suggestedFix: Avoid start_paused; rely on observable barriers.
